description:
If your business has lots of Macs, what do you do with them at night? And how much money do you spend on AI inferencing?

What if the computational power of those Macs could be used to handle some inferencing tasks? A new white paper from Apple’s machine learning team tells us it’s possible.

title: Apple’s ‘Minions’ tech turns idle Macs into an AI data center

description:
A Delaware jury found that Arm breached its licensing agreement with Qualcomm but awarded the chipmaker just $2 in damages, leaving a potentially multibillion-dollar dispute over royalty payments unresolved.

The jury ruled on October 13 that Arm had failed to provide software patches and development tools required under its agreement with Qualcomm. It also found that Arm had interfered with Qualcomm’s business relationship with Meta Platforms, while rejecting several other allegations against Arm.

Qualcomm is seeking to invoke a contractual provision that would allow it to stop paying royalties
title: Arm-Qualcomm legal fight ends in limited verdict, larger stakes remain

description:
As Microsoft adds more advanced agentic capabilities to Copilot, such as Cowork and Autopilot, usage-based pricing is becoming an increasingly important part of its business model.

But for customers used to predictable, fixed pricing, the addition of pay-as-you-go billing can be a significant change, creating new challenges around managing and predicting costs.

title: Copilot pricing gets complicated
